source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps coercive kingship attempt, Jesus’ knowledge, and solitary withdrawal.
key_decisions.before: Jesus knew they were about to come and seize him to make him king, so he withdrew again to the mountain by himself.
key_decisions.after: Jesus knew they were about to come and seize him to make him king, so he withdrew again to the mountain by himself.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Therefore Jesus, knowing that they were about to come and seize him to make him king, withdrew again to the mountain by himself.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves work contrast, abiding food, gift, Son of Man, Father, and seal.
key_decisions.before: Do not work for food that perishes, but for food that remains to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give you. For God the Father has set his seal on him.”
key_decisions.after: Do not work for food that perishes, but for food that remains for eternal life, which the Son of Man will give you. For God the Father has set his seal on him.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Work not for the food that perishes, but for the food that remains to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give to you; for this one the Father, God, has sealed.”

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps self-identification, coming-believing parallel, and emphatic satisfaction.
key_decisions.before: Jesus said, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will never be hungry, and whoever trusts in me will never be thirsty.
key_decisions.after: Jesus told them, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will certainly never hunger, and whoever believes in me will certainly never thirst.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Jesus said to them, “I am the bread of life; the one coming to me will certainly not hunger, and the one believing in me will certainly never thirst.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps inability, Father’s drawing, sending, and resurrection.
key_decisions.before: No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws that person, and I will raise them up on the last day.
key_decisions.after: No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws that person, and I will raise them up on the last day.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: No one is able to come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him, and I will raise him up on the last day.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves living bread, descent, eating, eternal life, flesh, gift, and world.
key_decisions.before: I am the living bread that came down from heaven. If anyone eats from this bread, they will live forever. And the bread I will give for the life of the world is my flesh.”
key_decisions.after: I am the living bread that came down from heaven. If anyone eats this bread, they will live forever. And the bread I will give for the life of the world is my flesh.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: I am the living bread that came down from heaven; if anyone eats from this bread, he will live forever; and the bread that I will give is my flesh for the life of the world.”

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps solemn condition, flesh, blood, title, and inward life.
key_decisions.before: Jesus said, “Truly, truly, I tell you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you do not have life in yourselves.
key_decisions.after: Jesus told them, “Truly, truly, I tell you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you do not have life in yourselves.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Therefore Jesus said to them, “Truly, truly, I say to you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you do not have life in yourselves.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps Spirit-flesh contrast without canceling Jesus’ earlier positive flesh language, and identifies words with life.
key_decisions.before: The Spirit is the one who gives life; the flesh is of no help. The words I have spoken to you are Spirit and life.
key_decisions.after: The Spirit gives life; the flesh is of no help by itself. The words I have spoken to you are Spirit and life.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: The Spirit is the one giving life; the flesh profits nothing. The words that I have spoken to you are spirit and are life.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps completed belief-knowledge and pinned title.
key_decisions.before: We have trusted and have come to know that you are the Holy One of God.”
key_decisions.after: We have come to believe and know that you are the Holy One of God.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: and we have believed and have come to know that you are the Holy One of God.”
